messages:
lina_support: Customer acme-labs opened a ticket — huge unexpected credit burn on embeddings overnight (~120k tokens charged, expected ~3k). They say nightly ingest ran once. Ticket #12345. Attaching their logs they pasted below.

sanjay_eng: can you drop the request_ids + model used and the approximate timestamps? also which SDK/version?

lina_support: pasted from customer:
```
2026-03-16T02:03:11Z POST /v1/embeddings 200 req_id=rid_02a1a trace=tr_09f
2026-03-16T02:03:12Z POST /v1/embeddings 500 req_id=rid_02a2a trace=tr_09f
2026-03-16T02:03:13Z POST /v1/embeddings 200 req_id=rid_02a2b trace=tr_09f
2026-03-16T02:03:14Z POST /v1/embeddings 200 req_id=rid_02a3a trace=tr_09g
```
They say worker restarted by k8s backoff twice during the 02:03 minute window. SDK: python-redwood 0.8.1, endpoint: /v1/embeddings, model: open-embed-ix-2. Batch size ~512.
```
```

emma_sre: :eyes: that pattern smells like retry storm + duplicate writes. If the job re-executed the same batch after a transient 500 and the client retried without idempotency, each successful call will be billed.

sanjay_eng: do we have server-side idempotency for embeddings? i thought we rely on client-provided idempotency-key header. if customer didn't set one, retries will look like new requests. also note our ingestion path does write-ahead caching + async worker ack; need to confirm whether our call path does dedupe on trace id.

cory_billing: putting a hold on acme-labs invoice while we investigate. provisional credit possible but need proof of double-charges. please collect our request logs for that timeframe (ingress + billing events).

lina_support: customer says they didn't set Idempotency-Key. They run a cron job that uses a cronjob controller with restartPolicy: OnFailure (so it will restart pods that crash). They saw pod restart 2x during the window.

sanjay_eng: posting quick repro hypothesis: their worker sends N batches sequentially. If pod crashes after a POST returns 500 but before it confirms, the controller restarts and the worker resends same payload. Because no idempotency-key, our backend treats it as new request and charges. The 200/500/200 interleaving in their logs matches that.

sanjay_eng: short-term mitigation: we can add a warning in the SDK and docs to encourage setting Idempotency-Key for batch jobs. mid-term: add server-side dedupe using a strong client hash (payload sha256 + account id) with a TTL. long-term: make embeddings endpoint idempotent by default for identical payloads within X minutes.

emma_sre: I'm going to grep ingress logs for trace=tr_09f and tr_09g across the fleet to see if we have repeated request_id patterns and to confirm billing events correlated with those traces.

ingest-bot: automated note: billing.events for acct=acme-labs during 2026-03-16T02:02:00Z..2026-03-16T02:06:00Z -> 118,912 embedding tokens consumed across 6 POSTs (ids: rid_02a1a,rid_02a2a,rid_02a2b,rid_02a3a,rid_02a4a,rid_02a5a).

cory_billing: thanks. provisional credit approved for 100k tokens while eng confirms root cause. we'll require eng signoff before final closure.

lina_support: conveyed to customer. they asked for concrete steps to avoid this. proposed checklist: 1) set Idempotency-Key header (uuid per batch) 2) make cronjob restart policy Never and handle retries externally 3) add narrow retry logic for 429/503 only with jittered backoff 4) upgrade SDK to v0.8.3 when released.

sanjay_eng: action items: (A) sres to confirm repeated traces + if any internal replay (emma) (B) eng to prototype server-side dedupe and estimate rollout cost (me) (C) devex to add SDK warning + docs (lina) (D) billing to stage credit (cory). ETA: 48h for initial findings.

emma_sre: found duplicate traces all tied to same CronJob name acme-ingest-2026. I also see k8s events: "Back-off restarting failed container" around 02:03. No internal replay on our side. conclusion: client-side retries + pod restarts = duplicate billing.

sanjay_eng: agree. I'll open a follow-up PR for a quick server-side dedupe prototype (sha256 payload key, 5 minute TTL) and post benchmark.

cory_billing: once eng + sre confirm, we'll finalize the credit and update invoice. I'll keep a note to mark this as "preventable by idempotency" in the billing playbook.

lina_support: customer happy with provisional credit and checklist. closing loop tonight after eng PR. thanks team :thumbsup:
